# Rent Me and My Truck LLC

> Locally owned junk removal, hauling, delivery, and cleanout service based in Corpus Christi, Texas, serving the greater Coastal Bend. Known for same/next-day service, upfront pricing, and doing the lifting for you. Rated 4.9 stars across 40 Google reviews. Licensed and insured. Open 7 days a week including evenings.

## About

- **Business:** Rent Me and My Truck LLC
- **Owner/operator:** Eddie (started the business in 2023)
- **Location:** Corpus Christi, TX (mobile service — we come to you)
- **Rating:** 4.9 stars, 40 Google reviews
- **Licensed & insured**
- **Phone / text:** 361-332-0123
- **Email:** rentmeandmytruck@yahoo.com
- **Hours:** 7 days a week, including evenings
- **Payments accepted:** Cash, credit/debit card, Cash App, check
- **Discounts:** 10% for seniors, military, and first responders

## Pricing

- Minimums start at **$99**.
- Most jobs are priced by how much space the load takes in the dump trailer, plus labor and distance.
- No hourly surprises — text a photo of the job to **361-332-0123** and get a straight price before the crew shows up.
- Most jobs are done in one trip; larger jobs may take an extra load or two, quoted up front.

## Services

- **Junk removal** — furniture, appliances, mattresses, hot tubs, sheds, general junk
- **Debris haul-off** — construction/renovation debris, yard and brush cleanup
- **Cleanouts** — estate, hoarding, garage, and full-property cleanouts
- **Commercial junk removal** — offices, retail, restaurants, rentals, build-outs
- **Delivery & hauling** — furniture, appliances, store/marketplace pickups, storage-unit loading, moving help
- **Transport** — single heavy items, equipment, motorcycles, golf carts

## Service area

Corpus Christi, Portland, Ingleside, Aransas Pass, Robstown, Calallen, Flour Bluff, Padre Island, Rockport, Odem, Sinton, and Mathis, TX — the greater Coastal Bend.
